entries.title: Audition
entries.org: AI pre-interview for job applications · Co-founder
entries.why: An AI interview before the first conversation. Companies see who can really do the job.
text: Audition started at the SF Tech Week Hackathon. Since then, I have been building it further as a startup.

The company enters the role and requirements. The AI suggests questions, and the company approves them. Applicants answer via a link in a continuous video recording, and the company then sees an evaluation.
points: A pre-interview that companies send to many applicants before a person holds the first conversation
Screen, voice and person are recorded
Application to a16z speedrun

entries.title: Concentr8
entries.org: Focus app specialized for neurodivergent people · Backend
entries.why: An app that brings you back to the task while studying, before you notice it yourself.
text: I built Concentr8 this semester at UC Berkeley. It started at Cal Hacks 13.0 in San Francisco, and we then merged it with our project from the Technology Entrepreneurship course.
I build the backend, together with Jinyuan Xu and Camila Scotti Pinto.
points: Mac app that blocks distracting apps and websites during a study session
Calls at fixed study times: morning, noon, evening
AI chat that first asks questions and then proposes a plan with study sessions
Sign-in with Google, the calendar is connected

entries.title: Semester abroad
entries.why: A semester at one of the best universities for computer science, in the middle of the AI startup ecosystem.
text: I am studying for one semester in Berkeley through the Berkeley International Study Program. Besides the courses, I take every opportunity to join hackathons.
points: Artificial Intelligence (CS 188)
Cryptography (CS 171)
Technology Entrepreneurship (ENGIN 183E)

entries.title: Tutor for Operations Research
entries.org: TU München · Chair of Prof. Kolisch
entries.why: Selected because I was among the top 5% in the course. I then taught it myself.
text: I held the tutorial for "Operations Research and Decision Analysis" in the winter semester 2025/26 and the summer semester 2026, along with one-on-one support. I completed the course itself with a grade of 1.3.
points: 4 hours of tutorial per week for around 25 students
Simplex, network flows, integer optimization
Modeling with Gurobi

entries.title: Fellow, Strategy and Transformation Consulting

photo.alt: Me with a laptop at the train station on the way to the client

entries.why: A large transformation project for a major German bank, seen from the inside.
text: ritzenhoefer & company advises large banks, insurers and industrial companies on major restructurings. I was mostly on site with the client and supported the project office.
points: Took technical and organizational responsibility for runbook reporting, automating parts of it with Excel macros
Improved the change request process, managing over 70 change requests
Created presentations up to the steering committee level
Developed a job-sharing model for senior consultants

entries.title: Business Development Internship
entries.org: comstruct · Software for the construction sector

photo.alt: Me with a colleague in the comstruct office

entries.why: Onboarded 74 suppliers in nine weeks at a Series A startup.
text: comstruct digitizes materials procurement for construction companies: delivery notes, invoices and orders are handled digitally with suppliers. I was on the go-to-market team.
points: Onboarded 74 suppliers in 9 weeks by phone and email
Analyzed and improved the supplier onboarding process
Represented comstruct at the BAUMA trade fair
Organized team events for the whole company

entries.title: Shapely
entries.why: Scan with your phone, get the printed part delivered home. Above all, I learned when to let go of an idea.
text: A web app for orders and an iPhone app that captures parts with the LiDAR scanner and turns them into a print-ready file. I later moved away from the "app for end customers" model.
points: Prototype of the iPhone app with ARKit, LiDAR and Supabase
Critically examined the business model and discarded it

entries.why: Business and computer science in one degree, in a program with a 9% acceptance rate.

points: Grade average 1.6
Specialization in Computer Engineering

entries.title: Internship in Networking and Programming
entries.org: cycos AG · a company of Eviden (Atos)

photo.alt: Me in front of the cycos logo

entries.why: First time setting up servers and virtual machines myself and programming in Java.
text: cycos has been developing telecommunications software for over 30 years, from analog systems to cloud collaboration. I spent four weeks on the development team.
points: Networking fundamentals: IP addresses, routing, protocols
Linux, servers and VMs with Proxmox
Java with object-oriented programming
Insight into telephony and VoIP

entries.title: Co-Founder and Board Member
entries.org: Future Founders Initiative e.V. · advisory board since 08.2026

photo.alt: Group photo at a Future Founders Initiative event

entries.why: Five people grew into an initiative in three cities. Then I deliberately handed it over.
text: The Future Founders Initiative brings together students who want to start a company: free workshops from the first idea to the pitch. I co-founded it, helped build it up on the board, and moved to the advisory board in 2026.
points: Three-day events for over 110 students
Locations in München, Frankfurt and Stuttgart
Set up a new board structure
Developed values together: doers rather than spectators, being there for each other, leaving something behind, no ego

entries.title: Field trips to the Emirates
entries.org: University of Duisburg-Essen and UAE University
entries.why: As a student, I traveled three times with university students to understand structural change.
text: The field trips were part of the DAAD program "Hochschuldialog mit der islamischen Welt" (University Dialogue with the Islamic World). They focused on the transition away from coal and oil, comparing the Ruhr region and the Emirates.
points: Ten days each of field research and encounters
Together with students from both universities
